blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: Incidental conversation contaminates generated clinical notes
blocks.zh: 意外谈话污染了临床笔记

blocks.en: For MedDistractNotes, we assembled 577 patient–clinician dialogues from ACI-Bench (77 full visits) 18 and MTS-Dialog (500 excerpts) 19 . Excluding one clinician-only excerpt left 576 encounters. After assigning each encounter an organ-system label from its clinical content (Methods), we created bystander and nonliteral versions by inserting small-talk exchanges with the transcript’s speaker labels. Bystander exchanges described a named third party’s non-communicable condition or elective procedure, selected from 67 conditions in the same organ system. Examples included a coworker’s coronary stent during a cardiovascular visit and a friend’s father’s lithotripsy during a genitourinary visit. We used relatives only in exchanges about injuries and elective procedures to avoid introducing hereditary risk. Nonliteral exchanges drew from 24 items, such as the band “The Strokes” in a neurological visit or a rowing boat named “Cataract” in an eye visit. The clinician’s reply continued the conversation without offering advice. Automated checks rejected exchanges in which the patient reported a symptom of their own. The clean and distracted transcripts differed only by the inserted lines (Fig. 1a).
blocks.zh: 我们从ACI-Bench(77个全程访问)18和MTC-Dialog(500个节选)中召集了577个病人-临床对话。 19. 不包括一个只有临床医生的摘录,留下了576次接触。 我们从临床内容(Methods)中指定了每个器官系统标签, 旁观者交流描述了一个被命名的第三方的非传染条件或选修程序,从同一机关系统中的67个条件中选出. 例如,一名同事在心血管检查期间患了冠心病;一名朋友的父亲在基因检查期间患了打字术。 我们只在交换伤情和选举程序时使用亲属,以避免产生遗传风险。 非文学交流取自24个项目,例如神经系统访问中的乐队“The Strokes”或名为“Cataract”的划船眼睛访问中的乐队。 临床医生的回答继续了谈话,但没有提出建议。 自动检查拒绝患者报告自己症状的交换。 干净和分散注意力的记录只因插入的行而异(图1a)。

blocks.en: We evaluated four frontier models (GPT-5.4, GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5 and Claude Fable 5.1) and four open-weight models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B and Gemma-2-9B), each generating subjective, objective, assessment and plan (SOAP) notes. Each four-model group, termed a cohort, contributed 576 encounters × \times two perturbation families × \times four models = 4,608 matched clean–distracted note pairs. Across both cohorts this yielded 9,216 pairs (18,432 note records). We report results separately for the two model groups.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了四个前沿模型(GPT-5.4,GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5和Claude Fable 5.1)和四个开放量级模型(Llama-3.1-8B,Quen2.5-7B,Mistral-7B和Gemma-2-9B),每个模型生成主观,客观,评估和计划(SOAP)注释. 每个被称作"一队"的四模式组共贡献了576次相遇, 这两组人共获得9 216对(18 432张纸币记录)。 我们为两个示范小组分别报告结果。

blocks.en: Our primary endpoint was target-specific contamination, defined as the inappropriate inclusion of the inserted aside as clinically meaningful information. To assess this, an LLM judge (Claude Sonnet 5) 20 reviewed the paired notes in a blinded, randomized order alongside a one-sentence description of the aside. The model then assigned a separate binary contamination score to each note. Clean notes served as within-pair negative controls (Methods; Supplementary Note 1).
blocks.zh: 我们的主要终点是针对特定目标的污染,被定义为不适当地将插入的污染作为临床上有意义的信息。 为了评估这一点,一名LLM法官(Claude Sonnet 5)20以盲目、随机排列的顺序审查了配对的笔记,同时对旁观者作了一判决的描述。 该模型随后为每个音符分别分配了二进制污染分. 清洁纸条是内部的负面控制(方法;补充说明1)。

blocks.en: Frontier models wrote the aside into 1,612 of 4,608 distracted notes (35.0%, 95% CI 33.6–36.3); no clean frontier note was flagged (0 of 4,608; Fig. 2a and Extended Data Fig. 1). Rates were 8.9% for GPT-5.4, 13.2% for GPT-5.6 Sol, 50.2% for Claude Fable 5.1 and 67.6% for Claude Opus 5. Bystander content entered notes more often than nonliteral content (43.9% versus 26.1%; model ranges 15.6–76.4% and 2.3–58.9%). Open-weight models incorporated the aside into 2,309 of 4,608 distracted notes (50.1%), with 4 of 4,608 clean notes flagged (0.09%). The paired increase was 50.0 percentage points (95% CI 48.6–51.5), with distracted-note rates ranging from 38.9% for Gemma-2-9B to 62.2% for Qwen2.5-7B. Bystander content was again incorporated more often (59.1% versus 41.1%).
blocks.zh: 边疆模型在4 608个分心音符中的1 612个(35.0%,95%CI 33.6-36.3个);没有标出干净的边疆音符(4 608个0个;图2a和扩展数据图1)。 GPT-5.4%、GPT-5.2%、Sol、Claude Fable 5.1%、Claude Opus 567.6%。 旁观者输入的注释多于非文体内容(43.9%对26.1%;模型范围为15.6-76.4%和2.3-58.9%). 开放重量型号在4,608个分心音符中的2,309个(50.1%),其中4,608个清洁音符中的4个标出(0.09%)。 配对增长为50.0个百分点(95% CI 48.6–51.5),分心率从Gemma-2-9B的38.9%到Quen2.5-7B的62.2%不等. 旁观者的内容再次被更频繁地吸收(59.1%对41.1%).

blocks.en: Contamination was greatest in short transcripts, where the aside occupied a larger share of the text. MTS-Dialog excerpts were short (median 350 characters), and the insertion accounted for a median of 43% of the distracted transcript. Frontier models incorporated it into 40.0% of notes; the contamination increase declined monotonically from 60.1 percentage points in the shortest quintile to 17.0 in the longest (Spearman ρ \rho = − - 0.31; open-weight cohort 85.0 to 19.2, ρ \rho = − - 0.48; Fig. 2e). In ACI-Bench full visits (median 6,538 characters; aside 4% of the text), frontier contamination was 2.6% (95% CI 1.5–3.9), and open-weight contamination was 3.7% (Fig. 2c). Generated-note length is shown separately in Supplementary Fig. 1.
blocks.zh: 在简短的文字记录中,污染程度最大,其中一方占了案文的较大份额。 MTS-Dialog节录很短(中间为350个字符),插入占分心记录的中位数为43%。 边疆模型将其纳入40.0%的纸币中;污染增加的单调性下降,从最短的五分之一的60.1%下降到最长的17.0%(Spearman à rho = − - 0.31;开放重量组群85.0到19.2;ρ-0.48;图2e)。 在ACI-Bench全程访问中(中间为6,538个字符;除文字的4%外),边境污染为2.6%(95% CI 1.5-3.9),露天污染为3.7%(图2c)。 生成的注长在"补充图"中单独显示. 1. 联合国

blocks.en: Attribution errors alter histories, assessments and plans
blocks.zh: 分配错误改变历史、评估和计划

blocks.en: To determine whether the model simply recorded the aside or used the aside in the patient’s assessment or plan, we used a second LLM judge to evaluate all flagged notes. We report three outcomes: (1) misattribution of the aside to the patient, (2) correct attribution with use in the patient’s assessment or plan, or (3) correct attribution without any clinical use (Methods).
blocks.zh: 为了确定模型是否只是记录在病人的评估或计划中的边,我们用第二个LLM法官来评价所有标注的笔记。 我们报告三种结果:(1) 将部分错归病人,(2) 在病人的评估或计划中使用正确归属,或(3) 在没有任何临床用途的情况下正确归属(方法)。

blocks.en: In the cohort of frontier models (n = 4,608 distracted notes), 1,422 notes (30.9% of all distracted notes) recorded the content without clinical use (Fig. 2b). Another 2.0% misattributed the content (95% CI 1.6–2.3), and 1.7% used it clinically despite correct attribution (95% CI 1.4–2.1). Within this cohort, misattribution was most frequent for Claude Opus 5 (4.6%, 95% CI 3.5–5.8), followed by Claude Fable 5.1 (2.0%), GPT-5.6 Sol (1.0%), and GPT-5.4 (0.3%). Clinical use of correctly attributed content occurred almost exclusively in Claude Opus 5 (5.6%).
blocks.zh: 在一组前沿模型(n = 4,608分心笔记)中,1,422分心笔记(占所有分心笔记的30.9%)记录的内容没有临床使用(图2b). 另有2.0%错误地分配了内容(95% CI 1.6 – 2.3),1.7%在临床上使用,尽管正确的归属(95% CI 1.4–2.1)。 在这一组人中,克洛德·奥普斯5(4.6%,95%CI 3.5–5.8)的归属不当最为常见,其次是克洛德·福克5.1(2.0%)、GPT-5.6 Sol(1.0%)和GPT-5.4(0.3%)。 Claude Opus 5(5.6%)几乎完全使用正确归属的内容。

blocks.en: In contrast, misattribution was the predominant outcome for open-weight models, affecting 25.7% of distracted notes (95% CI 24.4–27.0). This error rate ranged from 11.6% for Gemma-2-9B to 33.1% for Mistral-7B. An additional 4.1% of open-weight notes used the content clinically despite correct attribution, and 19.8% recorded it without such use. Observed misattribution rates were lower for exchanges about relatives than for exchanges about non-relatives (0.9% versus 1.2% in frontier models; 21.4% versus 26.7% in open-weight models), though their incorporation rates were similar (44.2% versus 43.7% and 57.4% versus 60.3%, respectively). Figurative remarks were misattributed more often than bystander conditions in both cohorts (2.8% versus 1.1% and 27.0% versus 24.4%). These exploratory comparisons are quantified in Supplementary Note 3.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,过度分配是开放重量模型的主要结果,影响到25.7%的分心音符(95% CI 24.4-27.0)。 这种出错率从Gemma-2-9B的11.6%到Mistral-7B的33.1%不等. 另有4.1%的露天笔记尽管有正确的归属,但在临床上使用内容,19.8%的记录没有这种使用. 观察到的亲属交流的分摊率低于非亲属交流的分摊率(前沿模式为0.9%对1.2%;开放式模式为21.4%对26.7%),尽管其参与率相近(分别为44.2%对43.7%和57.4%对60.3%)。 在两个组别中,比旁观者更经常出现错报(2.8%对1.1%和27.0%对24.4%)。 这些探索性比较在补充说明3中作了量化。

blocks.en: We grouped the 170 frontier notes with misattributed or acted-on content by failure mode, using the transcripts and judge rationales (Fig. 2d, Extended Data Fig. 2a and Table 1; Methods). In 24 notes, another individual’s condition became the patient’s complaint or diagnosis. Another clinician’s remark that “my cousin had a mild concussion after falling off a bike” produced a chief complaint of “mild concussion after falling off a bike” and a matching primary diagnosis (GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.6 Sol). A mail carrier’s sebaceous cyst became the patient’s “status post sebaceous cyst removal from the neck”. In 23 notes, a condition became family history or a risk factor despite the fact that relatives were mentioned only for injuries or elective procedures.
blocks.zh: 我们利用记录誊本和判断理由(图2d,扩展数据图2a和表1;方法),将170个前沿笔记按失败模式分类,并按错误或实际内容分类。 在24个笔记中,另一个人的情况成为病人的申诉或诊断。 另一位临床医生说, " 我表弟从自行车上摔下来后受到轻度脑震荡 " ,他提出了 " 从自行车上摔下来后受到轻度脑震荡 " 和相应的初级诊断(GPT-5.4和GPT-5.6 Sol)。 邮件载体的静脉囊肿变成了病人的 " 静脉囊肿从颈部切除后的状况 " 。 在23份说明中,一个条件成为了家庭历史或风险因素,尽管亲属只因受伤或选择程序而被提及。

blocks.en: In 24 notes, the aside was treated as an unvoiced concern and prompted screening or counselling. One note correctly attributed basal cell carcinoma to a friend but stated that the remark “may reflect an unvoiced concern about personal skin cancer risk” and recommended exploring skin concerns, with skin examination or referral conditional on concerns or suspicious lesions (Claude Opus 5). The largest group, 37 notes, documented small talk as a mental-status or psychiatric finding. A coffee shop named “Delirium” became “a tangential/off-topic remark” and led to a recommendation for “objective screening”; a sourdough starter that “went into remission” became a “tangential/circumstantial response” with a planned mental-status examination. A joke about panicking at video-game timers prompted clarification of anxiety symptoms and conditional screening, although the note stated that no anxiety diagnosis was supported. A further 18 notes treated figurative remarks as literal facts: a laptop with “chronic fatigue” was taken as evidence of a remote encounter. In 33 notes, a third party’s activity became the patient’s own.
blocks.zh: 在24个注解中,该部分被视为一个未表达的关切,并引起筛查或咨询。 一份说明正确地将玄武细胞癌归因于一位朋友,但指出,该评论“可能反映了对个人皮肤癌风险的不公开关切”,并建议探讨皮肤方面的关切,对皮肤进行检查或转诊以关切或可疑的损伤为条件(克洛德·奥普斯5)。 最大的群体,37个笔记,记录了作为精神状态或精神状态发现的小型谈话. 一家名为“Delirium”的咖啡店成为“不切实际/不切实际的言论”,并导致建议进行“客观筛选”;一个“逐渐得到缓解”的起步器成为“直接/循环反应”,并计划进行精神状况检查。 一个在视频游戏计时器上惊慌失措的笑话引发了焦虑症状的澄清和有条件的筛选,虽然该说明称没有焦虑诊断的支持. 还有18个注解将比喻性言论视为文字事实:一种带有“慢性疲劳症”的手提电脑被作为远程接触的证据。 33个笔记中,第三方的活动成为病人自己的活动。

blocks.en: Across frontier models, inserted content appeared in the assessment or plan in 6.8% of distracted notes, with rates ranging from 1.7% (GPT-5.6 Sol) to 16.3% (Claude Opus 5). An automated text-matching rule detected action language near the inserted content in 4.9% of distracted notes, rising to 19.4% for Claude Opus 5 during bystander exchanges. This rule does not establish that a clinical action was taken. Specifically, in the subset of notes that incorporated the aside, 5–23% contained it in the assessment or plan (Extended Data Fig. 2b). The paired judge’s severity scores are shown by model and perturbation family in Extended Data Fig. 2c. These scores were not clinically validated.
blocks.zh: 跨边界模型,插入的内容出现在评估或计划中6.8%的分心笔记中,比例从1.7%(GPT-5.6 Sol)到16.3%(Claude Opus5)。 自动文本比对规则在4.9%的分心音符中检测到插入内容附近的动作语言,在旁观者交换时克洛德·奥普斯5的动作语言上升到了19.4%. 这一规则没有确定是否采取了临床行动。 具体地说,在包含该部分的注释子集中,5-23%将其包含在评估或计划中(扩展数据图2b)。 配对法官的重度分数由模型和扰动家族在扩展数据图2c中显示. 这些分数没有经过临床验证.

blocks.en: Model cohorts differ in the clinical errors they generate
blocks.zh: 模型组的临床误差不同

blocks.en: We observed a difference in how open-weight and frontier models handled incidental content. Open-weight models were substantially more prone to directly assigning incidental content to the patient, exhibiting overall incorporation and misattribution rates of 50.1% and 25.7%, compared with 35.0% and 2.0% in frontier models, respectively. Every open-weight model misattributed content more frequently than the worst-performing frontier model (11.6–33.1% versus 0.3–4.6%).
blocks.zh: 我们注意到开放重量模型和前沿模型处理附带内容的方式不同。 开放重量模式更倾向于直接将附带内容分配给患者,其整体融入率和误配率分别为50.1%和25.7%,而前沿模式分别为35.0%和2.0%。 每一个开放量级模型的误配内容比表现最差的前沿模型更频繁(11.6-33.1 %对0.3-4.6%).

blocks.en: We observed a shift in the qualitative nature of these errors between open-weight and frontier models. Among the 1,371 misattributed or acted-on notes generated by open-weight models, the predominant failure was the direct transfer of a bystander’s history to the patient. In 39% of these cases (n = 541), another person’s condition was improperly documented as the patient’s complaint, diagnosis, or surgical history. These models also converted small talk into mental-status findings (18%, n = 244) and treated figurative remarks as medical facts (15%, n = 203). Conversely, family-history errors (80 notes) and inferred concerns (45 notes) drove a much smaller proportion of errors here than in the frontier cohort.
blocks.zh: 我们看到这些错误的质量在开放重量模型和前沿模型之间发生了变化。 在开放量模型产生的1,371个误配或动作笔记中,主要的失败是将旁观者的历史直接转移给病人。 在其中39%的病例(n=541)中,另一人的病情被不当记录为病人的投诉、诊断或外科史。 这些模型还将小谈转化为精神状态的发现(18%,n = 244),并将比喻性言论作为医学事实(15%,n = 203)处理. 相反,家庭-历史错误(80个注释)和推断出的关切(45个注释)在这方面造成的错误比例要小于前沿群体。

blocks.en: Frontier notes retain high quality scores despite contamination
blocks.zh: 尽管受到污染,但边框记录仍保持高分

blocks.en: To evaluate whether standard rubrics capture this vulnerability, an independent LLM judge (GPT-5.4) scored notes against a reference standard for clinical correctness, completeness, succinctness, and overall quality. Despite 35.0% of distracted frontier notes containing contaminated content, their quality scores remained virtually unchanged (Fig. 2f). On a five-point scale, average frontier scores shifted by at most 0.20 points between clean and distracted conditions: clinical correctness declined by 0.02 (95% CI − - 0.04 to − - 0.01) and completeness by 0.05, while succinctness and overall quality increased slightly (+0.20 and +0.08 [95% CI 0.06–0.10], respectively). Open-weight notes had lower baseline overall quality (3.0 versus 4.0) and lost 0.27 points of clinical correctness (95% CI 0.24–0.31), 0.23 of completeness and 0.23 of overall quality under distraction. These declines indicated poorer notes but did not identify the attribution error.
blocks.zh: 为了评估标准标题是否反映了这种脆弱性,一位独立的LLM法官(GPT-5.4)根据临床正确性、完整性、简洁性和整体质量的参考标准评分了注释。 尽管35.0%的有被污染内容的分散注意力的边框说明,其质量得分几乎没有变化(图2f)。 在五分制中,平均前沿分数在清洁和分心状态之间最多0.20分时转移:临床正确性下降0.02(95% CI−-0.04至−0.01)和完整性下降0.05,而简洁性和整体质量则略有提高(+0.20和+0.08[分别为95% CI 0.06-0.10])。 开口重量笔记总质量较低(3.0比4.0),临床正确度损失了0.27分(95%CI 0.24-0.31),完整性损失了0.23分,整体质量损失了0.23分被分散。 这些下降表明附注更差,但没有指明归属错误。

blocks.en: Broader hallucination metrics were similarly unhelpful. A binary flag for statements absent from the transcript was positive in 70% of clean frontier notes and 92% of clean open-weight notes and shifted by less than 0.07 under distraction. Target-specific contamination was also detected when notes were evaluated separately. Using the same Claude Sonnet 5 judge and target-specific criterion, the distracted-minus-clean contamination differences were 32.8 percentage points for frontier models and 49.7 for open-weight models, closely mirroring the 35.0 and 50.0 point gaps observed under paired presentation. The single-note judge flagged 0% of clean notes in both cohorts (Extended Data Fig. 3; Supplementary Note 3).
blocks.zh: 更广泛的幻觉度量标准同样无济于事。 在70%的清洁边境笔记和92%的清洁露天笔记中,没有记录的言论的二进制旗帜是正面的,在分心下转移了不到0.07分. 在对说明进行单独评估时,也发现了特定目标污染。 使用同样的克洛德·索内特5判断和目标特定标准,分心-去除干净的污染差异是前沿模型的32.8个百分点和开放重量模型的49.7个百分点,这密切地反映了在对等演示中观察到的35.0和50.0分差距. 单音符法官在两个组别中标出干净音符的0%(扩展数据图;补充注3)。

blocks.en: Background speech contaminates transcripts and downstream notes
blocks.zh: 背景讲话会污染笔录和下游笔记

blocks.en: To determine whether a microphone capturing nearby conversations could corrupt clinical documentation, we constructed a pipeline using MedDistractAudio. In the 57 mock primary care consultations of PriMock57 21 , we overlaid a 5–15 s segment from donor consultations at four background levels. This produced 57 clean baseline recordings and 456 mixed recordings (114 per background level), which were transcribed by Whisper large-v3 22 and processed into notes by four open-weight models (Methods).
blocks.zh: 为了确定收录附近谈话的麦克风是否会破坏临床文献,我们用MedDistractAudio建造了一条管道. 在PriMock57 21的57次模拟初级保健咨询中,我们从四个背景层面的捐助者咨询中划出5至15个部分。 这产生了57个干净的基线录音和456个混合录音(每个背景级别为114个),由Whisper大V3 22所转录,并被四个开量型号(Methods)加工成笔记.

blocks.en: At the prespecified − - 10 dB level, content from the overlaid segment leaked into 48.2% of the mixed transcripts, where leakage meant that at least one content word from the overlaid segment appeared in the mixed transcript but not its clean control. This leakage alone does not establish a clinically consequential error. An average of 14.5% (95% CI 10.8–18.5) of the overlaid segment’s content words leaked into the transcript. Leakage increased with background volume, with at least one word leaking in 19.3% of recordings at − - 20 dB compared to 67.5% at − - 5 dB (Fig. 3a,b).
blocks.zh: 在预先指定的-- 10 dB 级别上,被覆盖部分的内容漏出48.2%的混音记录,其中的漏出意味着被覆盖部分至少有一个内容单词出现在混音记录中,而不是其干净的控制. 仅这种渗出并不能确定临床上的误差。 平均有14.5%(95% CI 10.8–18.5)的被覆盖部分的内容字漏入了记录. 泄漏量随着背景量的增加而增加,19.3%的录音在−-20分贝时至少漏出一字,而在−-5分贝时漏出67.5%(图3a,b)。

blocks.en: Background content also appeared in generated notes. At − - 10 dB, the judge detected background content in 24 of 456 downstream notes (5.3%, 95% CI 2.9–8.1), versus 1.3% of paired clean controls (mixed-minus-clean difference = 3.9 percentage points, 95% CI 1.3–7.0). This difference reached 8.6 points at − - 5 dB (Fig. 3c). Note contamination was associated with transcript leakage. At − - 10 dB, contamination occurred in 11.5% of notes originating from transcripts with at least one leaked word, compared with 0.6% from those without leakage (Fig. 3d). General quality scores changed little; on a five-point scale, clinical correctness shifted by − - 0.03 points (95% CI − - 0.11 to 0.05) and overall quality by − - 0.01 points ( − - 0.09 to 0.07).
blocks.zh: 背景内容也出现在生成的注释中. 在−-10分贝时,法官在456个下游音符中的24个(5.3%,95%CI 2.9-8.1)中检测出背景内容,而成对的清洁控制(混合-减-清洁差异=3.9个百分点,95%CI 1.3-7.0)则为1.3%。 这一差异在−-5分贝(图3c)时达到了8.6分. 说明污染与记录片泄漏有关。 在--10分贝时,11.5%来自至少一个字被漏出的记录,而0.6%来自没有漏出的记录(图3d)。 一般质量分数变化不大;在五分尺度上,临床正确度变化为--0.03分(95% CI−-0.11至0.05分),整体质量变化为--0.01分(−0.09至0.07分).

blocks.en: Mechanistic evidence for the dual-encoding hypothesis
blocks.zh: 双重编码假设的机械证据

blocks.en: To investigate whether the model components associated with distraction also contribute to clinical reasoning, we probed four open-weight models using MedDistractQA 7 . This benchmark pairs 1,273 USMLE-style questions 23 with perturbed variants inserting either a bystander or a nonliteral perturbation just before the final question. On a held-out test set comprising 10% of questions, these insertions caused baseline accuracy drops of 5.5–12.6 percentage points (bystander) and 10.2–14.2 points (nonliteral) (Fig. 4a).
blocks.zh: 为了调查与分心有关的模型组件是否也有助于临床推理,我们用MedDistractQA 7探测出四个开量模型。 这个基准对1,273 USMLE型问题23,在最后问题之前插入旁观者或非文体扰动。 在一个由10%的问题组成的搁置测试中,这些插入导致基线精度下降5.5至12.6个百分点(旁观者)和10.2至14.2分(非立体者)(图4a)。

blocks.en: To identify heads for intervention, we developed contrastive causal head gating (CCHG). Extending causal head gating 24 , CCHG identifies attention heads—components that combine information across the input—whose outputs contribute to the difference in correct-answer probability between clean and distracted inputs (Methods). CCHG selected a subset of heads: 1.5–1.7% in Llama-3.1-8B and up to 21.7–23.7% in Gemma-2-9B (Fig. 4b; Extended Data Table 1). The heads selected by bystander and nonliteral perturbations heavily overlapped. Jaccard similarities ranged from 0.39 to 0.78, exceeding the 0.008–0.1 expected by chance (Extended Data Table 1). The two perturbation families therefore selected overlapping, but not identical, head sets.
blocks.zh: 为了确定需要干预的头部,我们研制出有对比性的因果头指向(CCHG). CCHG在扩展因果头指向24时,确定了注意头——将信息综合到所有投入的成分——其产出促成了干净和分心的投入(方法)之间正确答案概率的差异。 CHG选择了一个子集头:Llama-3.1-8B为1.5-1.7%,Gemma-2-9B为21.7-23.7%(图4b;扩展数据表1)。 由旁观者和非文学干扰者选择的头部严重重叠. Jaccard相似度从0.39到0.78不等,超过了偶然预期的0.008-0.1(扩展数据表1)。 因此,两个扰动家庭选择了重叠但并不相同的头套。

blocks.en: To test whether intervening on these heads changes accuracy, we replaced their activations on distracted inputs with position-aligned activations from the clean input 25–27 . Accuracy increased in seven of eight model–perturbation conditions, rescuing 6.3–16.5 percentage points (six conditions yielded uncorrected exact McNemar P < 0.05). We observed the most pronounced rescue in Mistral-7B with nonliteral insertions, which improved from 40.2% to 56.7% accuracy (+16.5 percentage points, 95% CI 8.7–24.4). Patching these targeted heads outperformed patching random heads in seven conditions, yielding 83–117% of the gain observed when patching all heads in those seven conditions (Fig. 4c). Instructions to ignore irrelevant information or a chain-of-thought preamble did not consistently improve accuracy (Extended Data Fig. 5).
blocks.zh: 为了检验这些头部的干预是否改变准确性,我们用25–27的干净输入中的位置相配合活化器取代了被分散输入的激活器。 8个模型中的7个模型的准确性提高了,挽救了6.3-16.5个百分点(6个条件得出了未更正的准确McNemar P < 0.05)。 我们观察到在Mistral-7B省最显著的救援行动是非升入,精确度从40.2%提高到56.7%(+16.5个百分点,95%为CI 8.7-24.4)。 补上这些目标头在7个条件下超过了补上随机头的效果,在7个条件下补上所有头时得到83-117的增益(图4c)。 无视不相干的信息或思维链前言的指示没有始终提高准确性(扩展数据图5)。

blocks.en: Finally, we tested whether the selected heads also contribute to reasoning without distraction. Suppressing heads selected by CCHG on clean questions decreased accuracy by 24.4–37.8 percentage points across all eight conditions, compared with changes of − - 9.4 to +0.8 points when suppressing random heads (Fig. 4d).
blocks.zh: 最后,我们检验了被选中的头是否也为推理作出贡献而不分散注意力。 由CCHG在清洁问题上选择的将头进行压制,在所有8个条件中精确度都下降了24.4至37.8个百分点,相比之下,在压制随机头时将-- 9.4至+0.8分的变化(图4d).

blocks.en: Selected heads occurred throughout model depth (Extended Data Fig. 6) and, in seven of eight conditions, devoted 1.4–2.3 times as much attention to inserted tokens as other heads (Extended Data Fig. 7).
blocks.zh: 在模型深度(扩展数据图. 6)中选取了头部,在8个条件中的7个条件中,将1.4-2.3倍的注意力用于插入的指使(扩展数据图. 7).

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: We identify sensitivity to incidental information as a shared failure mode of LLM-based documentation and clinical reasoning. When tasked with drafting notes from text transcripts, frontier and open-weight models embedded incidental small talk into 35.0% and 50.1% of notes, respectively, despite the patient’s actual clinical information remaining unchanged. These errors ranged from assigning a bystander’s diagnosis to the patient, to interpreting casual small talk as evidence of psychiatric disturbance. When transcribing raw audio from mock clinical conversations, Whisper erroneously incorporated − - 10 dB background speech from separate consultations into 48.2% of transcripts, with contamination in 5.3% of downstream notes. General quality scores changed little despite these errors; thus, a generated note can appear clinically plausible and comprehensive yet contain assertions that are unsupported for the patient.
blocks.zh: 我们把对附带信息的敏感性确定为基于LLM的文献和临床推理的共同故障模式. 尽管患者的实际临床信息没有变化,但边疆模型和开放式模型在负责从文字记录中起草笔记时,将附带的小说分别嵌入35.0%和50.1%的笔记中。 这些错误从将旁观者诊断给病人,到将闲谈解释为精神紊乱的证据。 Whisper在将模拟临床对话的原始音频转换成48.2%的笔录时,错误地将10分贝背景发言从单独磋商中收录到下游5.3%的笔记中。 尽管存在这些错误,但一般质量的分数几乎没有变化;因此,生成的笔记似乎在临床上是可信的,是全面的,但包含了患者不支持的断言。

blocks.en: If retained in a signed medical record, unflagged errors risk influencing subsequent patient care. While our study measured the generation of errors rather than their downstream acceptance, prior audits of deployed scribes found that omissions were common but fabrications carried the highest severity of risk 11 . Our results show that even in frontier LLMs, accurate attribution alone cannot prevent these fabrications. While some models generally omitted incidental content, others frequently recorded and occasionally acted on it. For example, Claude Opus 5 treated a remark about a coffee shop named “Delirium” as tangential speech and recommended objective cognitive screening (Table 1). Such hallucinations mimic thoroughness while generating assessments unsupported by the patient’s actual presentation. A check for statements absent from the transcript can miss this failure mode because the source statement is present but does not describe the patient.
blocks.zh: 如果保留在署名的医疗记录中,未标出的错误有可能影响随后的病人护理。 虽然我们的研究衡量了错误的产生,而不是其下游接受情况,但先前对部署的文员的审计发现,遗漏是常见的,而捏造则具有最高程度的风险11。 我们的结果表明,即使在前沿有限责任公司,仅仅准确的归属并不能防止这些捏造。 虽然有些模型一般省略了附带内容,而另一些模型则经常记录并偶尔采取行动。 例如,克洛德·奥普斯5将关于一家名为“Delirium”的咖啡店的评论视为不切实际的言论,并建议进行客观的认知筛选(表1)。 这种幻觉模仿了彻底性,同时产生未经患者实际陈述支持的评估. 检查记录稿中缺少的语句可能会错过这种失败模式,因为源语句是存在的,但没有描述病人.

blocks.en: Mechanistically, our results support the proposed dual-encoding hypothesis. While restoring clean activations in selected attention heads rescued performance under distraction, suppressing them reduced accuracy on clean questions by 24.4–37.8 percentage points. The selected heads overlapped across bystander and nonliteral distractors, but CCHG can also select heads that support reasoning generally: it can narrow the probability gap by lowering the probability of correct clean answers. Prompting models to ignore irrelevant information or using a chain-of-thought preamble did not consistently improve accuracy. Future safeguards must therefore reduce distraction while preserving these components’ contribution to reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在机械方面,我们的成果支持提议的双重编码假设。 在恢复某些注意力头部的清洁活性的同时,在分心下挽救了性能,压制它们使清洁问题的准确性降低了24.4-37.8个百分点. 被选取的头部重叠到旁观者和非文学分心者之间,但CCHG也可以选择支持一般推理的头部:它可以通过降低正确干净答案的概率来缩小概率差距. 促使模型忽略无关信息或使用一连串思维的序言,并没有始终提高准确性。 因此,未来的保障措施必须减少分散注意力,同时保持这些组成部分对推理的贡献。

blocks.en: This study has notable limitations. First, while deliberately inserted exchanges and overlaid audio enabled highly controlled causal comparisons, they do not capture the full acoustic complexity and conversational variance of routine clinical practice. We noted that contamination was greatest in short excerpts, where the aside occupied a larger share of the transcript; therefore, our pooled estimates may overstate the contamination rate of full-length visits. Second, we evaluated generated notes and automated endpoints as opposed to downstream patient harm. Whether clinicians successfully catch these specific attribution errors before signing a note, and how retained errors influence subsequent care, requires prospective clinical evaluation. Finally, contamination and attribution were judged by a single LLM without clinician validation, with failure modes assigned using a set of automated rules. The mechanistic experiments used open-weight models and medical questions without testing on a general-knowledge benchmark, so clinical specificity remains unknown. We did not test reverse patching of distracted activations onto clean inputs or interventions during note generation.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有明显的局限性。 首先,虽然有意插入交换和覆盖的音频可以进行高度受控的因果比较,但它们并没有捕捉到常规临床实践的全部声学复杂性和对话差异. 我们注意到,污染最严重的是简短的摘录,在记录稿中,一方占了更大的份额;因此,我们的集合估计可能过分夸大了全长访问的污染率。 第二,我们评价了生成的笔记和自动终点,而不是下游病人的伤害。 临床医生在签署说明书之前是否成功地抓住了这些具体的归属错误,以及保留错误如何影响后续护理,都需要有未来的临床评估. 最后,污染和归属由一个没有临床医生鉴定的单一LLM来判断,使用一套自动规则来指定故障模式。 机械实验采用开量模型和医疗问题,而没有在一般知识基准上进行测试,因此临床特异性仍然未知. 我们没有测试在音符生成过程中将分心的活化作用反向补丁纳入干净的投入或干预。

blocks.en: Before ambient documentation systems can be safely deployed at scale, their sensitivity to incidental information—both to whom it is attributed and how it is clinically applied—must be rigorously evaluated. To support this, we will release MedDistractNotes and MedDistractAudio to provide the paired inputs and contamination-specific scoring methods necessary for this testing. Future safeguards may require structuring inputs to explicitly retain the speaker, subject and clinical relevance of each statement, new model training objectives focused on attribution, and verifying generated assertions against patient-relevant transcript spans. Mechanistic interventions during note generation could test whether the selected heads also contribute to documentation errors. Such benchmarks will allow documentation systems to be tested for attribution errors that general note-quality scores can miss.
blocks.zh: 在环境文件系统能够安全地大规模部署之前,必须严格评估其对附带信息——无论是归谁所有还是临床应用信息——的敏感性。 为支持这一点,我们将释放出 " 磁性分解说明 " (MedDistract Notes)和 " MedDistractAudio " (MedDistractAudio),为这次测试提供必要的配对投入和针对污染的评分方法。 未来的保障措施可能需要对投入进行结构安排,以明确保留发言者、每个发言的主题和临床相关性、注重归属的新示范培训目标,以及对照与病人有关的记录记录段核实所产生的断言。 制作说明期间的机械干预可以检验选定的负责人是否也造成文件错误。 这种基准将使文件系统能够测试一般说明质量分数可能错失的归属错误。

blocks.en: Methods
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: Study design. Every clean input (a transcript, recording or question) was paired with a distracted version containing the same patient information and reference material, differing only by the inserted content. The documentation and mechanistic arms shared two perturbation families. The prespecified primary documentation endpoint was the distracted-minus-clean rate of target-specific contamination in generated notes. Mechanistic endpoints were the fraction of heads selected by CCHG, the accuracy change after patching selected heads with clean activations relative to size-matched random heads, and the change in clean accuracy after suppressing selected heads. Attribution, failure-mode classification, note-quality scores, sensitivity analyses and learned per-head correction were exploratory. No data were collected from human participants. All corpora are public and contain de-identified or mock encounters. No institutional ethics determination was obtained for this analysis of public datasets.
blocks.zh: 研究设计. 每个干净的输入(笔录,录音或问题)都配有分心的版本,包含同样的病人信息和参考材料,只有插入的内容不同. 证件和机械武器共有两个骚扰家庭。 预先确定的主要文件终点是生成的纸币中特定目标污染的分心 -- -- 小于干净。 机械端点是CCHG所选头的分数,与大小相匹配的随机头相比,用干净活化补补选头后的精度变化,以及压制所选头后干净精度的变化. 归属、故障模式分类、笔记质量分数、敏感性分析和学识的人均校正都是探索性的。 没有从人类参与者那里收集数据。 所有蝎子都是公开的,包含去识别或模拟相遇. 对公共数据集的分析没有获得机构道德认定。

blocks.en: MedDistractNotes corpus. We used 577 patient–clinician dialogues from two public corpora released under CC BY 4.0. From ACI-Bench 18 we selected encounters from the “aci” source in the official validation set (11) and in the three test sets (22 each; 77 in total); training encounters and the other two sources were not used. From MTS-Dialog 19 we used Test Set 1 (200), Test Set 2 (200) and the validation set (100), whose dialogues are short exchanges corresponding to a single note section; the corresponding section text served as the reference note. ACI-Bench transcripts label speakers in square brackets (“[doctor]”, “[patient]”) and cover a whole visit (median 6,538 characters); MTS-Dialog transcripts use “Doctor:” and “Patient:” labels and are shorter (median 350 characters).
blocks.zh: 医护手册 我们使用577个病人-临床对话, 从ACI-Bench 18中,我们从官方验证组(11个)和三个测试组(各22个;共77个)的“aci”来源选择了相遇;培训相遇和另外两个来源没有使用。 从MTS-Dialog 19开始,我们使用了测试集1(200),测试集2(200)和验证集(100),它们的对话框是短的交换,对应单个注释部分;相应的章节文本作为参考说明. ACI-Bench录音记录片标注在方括号内(“医生”),“病人”并覆盖整个访问(中间6,538个字符); MTS-Dialog录音记录片使用“医生:”和“病人:”标签并较短(中间350个字符)。

blocks.en: Organ-system labelling. GPT-5.4 (temperature 0, JSON output, September 7, 2026) assigned an organ-system label to each of the 577 encounters using the clean transcript and reference note. It selected from twelve systems (musculoskeletal, cardiovascular, respiratory, gastrointestinal, neurological, genitourinary, endocrine, dermatological, psychiatric, ear–eye–dental, haematological–oncological, obstetric–gynaecological) or a “general” category for excerpts with no clinical content, such as an allergy list or a social history. The label was inferred from the chief complaint or any condition, symptom, examination, medication or question in the excerpt. The 177 excerpts labeled “general” were subsequently randomly assigned an organ system using a fixed seed. Labels and rationales will be released with the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 器官系统标签。 GPT-5.4(温度为0,JSON输出,2026年9月7日)使用干净的笔录和参考说明为577次相遇中的每一次都分配了器官系统标签. 它从12个系统(肌肉骨骼系统、心血管系统、呼吸系统、胃肠系统、神经系统系统、肠道系统、内分泌系统、皮肤系统、精神病系统、耳-眼-牙科系统、出血-肿瘤系统、产科-妇科系统)或 " 一般 " 类别中选取没有临床内容的摘录,如过敏清单或社会历史。 标签是从主要投诉或摘录中的任何状况、症状、检查、药物或问题推断出来的。 标有“一般”标签的177个节选随后被随机指定使用固定种子的器官系统。 标签和理由将随基准一同发布。

blocks.en: Insertion of incidental exchanges. For each encounter and each perturbation family, we asked GPT-5.4 (JSON output, temperature 0.3, September 7, 2026) to generate a three- to four-turn small-talk exchange using the transcript’s speaker labels, alongside a one-sentence summary and a suggested insertion point. The pipeline assigned the content of each aside from the visit’s organ system. Bystander content was a non-communicable condition or elective procedure of a named third party, drawn from a table of 67 conditions across the twelve systems (for example a coworker’s coronary stent in a cardiovascular visit, a sister’s knee replacement in a musculoskeletal visit, a friend’s father’s lithotripsy in a genitourinary visit). To reduce the chance of introducing hereditary risk, relatives were only used for injuries and elective procedures; conditions with any heritable component were assigned to non-relatives (e.g., coworkers, neighbours). Nonliteral content used a medical term as a title, name or figure of speech. We selected from 24 items mapped to relevant organ systems (e.g., the band “The Strokes” in a neurological or cardiovascular visit, a racehorse named “Palpitation”, a coffee shop called “Delirium”, a sourdough starter “in remission”, a rowing boat named “Cataract”).
blocks.zh: 插入附带交换。 我们要求GPT-5.4(JSON输出, 温度为0. 输油管指定了访问器官系统以外的每个管线的内容。 旁观者的内容是被命名的第三方的一个非传染条件或选修程序,该程序取自12个系统67个条件的表格(例如,心血管访查中同事的冠状结扎;姐妹的膝盖取而代之的是骨骼访查;朋友的父亲在肠道访查中做体外科手术)。 为了减少引入遗传风险的机会,亲属只用于伤害和选修程序;将任何遗传成分的条件分配给非亲属(例如同事、邻居)。 非文学内容使用医学术语作为标题,名称或语音图. 我们从24个被绘制到相关器官系统的物品中挑选出来(例如神经或心血管访问中的乐队“The Strokes”、一个名叫“Papitation”的赛马、一个叫“Delirium”的咖啡店、一个酸性起步器“缓解”、一个叫“Cataract”的划船)。

blocks.en: The prompt required the patient, or an accompanying family member or colleague, to raise the topic. The clinician was to reply conversationally without giving advice or announcing a return to the visit. The exchange could include one treatment detail about the other person (a procedure, device or medication name), but no symptom, condition, exposure or concern of the patient’s own. A fixed list of words that would suggest contagion, exposure or heredity was forbidden. Automated checks assessed turn count, speaker labels, length and inclusion of the assigned content. They also checked for forbidden words, patient statements about their own symptoms or body parts, and clinician-initiated openings. Exchanges that failed were regenerated (mean 1.02 and 1.15 attempts per bystander and nonliteral aside). One MTS-Dialog excerpt consisting of a single clinician sentence with no second speaker was excluded.
blocks.zh: 迅速要求病人或随行家属或同事提出这一专题。 临床医生应回答谈话,而不提供建议或宣布返回探视。 交换可以包括另一个人的治疗细节(程序、装置或药物名称),但不包括病人自己的症状、状况、接触或关切。 禁止用固定的词语表说明传染性、接触性或遗传性。 自动检查评估了转弯计数、扬声器标签、长度和指定内容的列入。 他们还检查禁言、病人关于自己症状或身体部位的陈述以及临床医生发起的开口。 失败的交换被重新生成( 平均 1. 02 和 1. 15 个尝试 / 旁观者和非文学 ) 。 不包括一个MTS-Dialog摘录,包括一个单一的临床医生判决,没有第二个发言者。

blocks.en: The final corpus contained 576 bystander and 576 nonliteral exchanges, spanning 66 conditions and 24 items. Sciatica was the most frequent bystander condition (21 of 576 exchanges, 3.6%); a football team’s “hernia” of a defence was the most frequent nonliteral item (50 of 576, 8.7%). Bystander and nonliteral exchanges averaged 3.3 and 3.6 turns and 265 and 255 characters. Within MTS-Dialog, insertions accounted for a median 43% of the distracted transcript. The exchange was spliced after the model-chosen turn in the transcript’s own speaker-label format (“[doctor]”/“[patient]” in ACI-Bench, “Doctor:”/“Patient:” in MTS-Dialog), so that the clean and distracted transcripts differed only by the inserted lines; the frozen exchanges, the organ-system labels and both generator prompts will be released with MedDistractNotes (Supplementary Note 1).
blocks.zh: 最终文书包括576个旁观者和576个非文体交换,涉及66个条件和24个物品。 Sciatica是最常见的旁观者条件(576个交换站中的21个,3.6%);一个足球队的 " 赫尔尼亚 " 防守是最常见的非文学项目(576个交换站中的50个,8.7%)。 旁观者和非文学交流平均有3.3和3.6个转弯和265和255个字符. 在MTS-Dialog系统中,插入占分散记录的中位数43%。 交换是在模型选择转换了ACI-Bench语中“医生:”/“医生:”/“病人:”的录音笔录格式(“[医生]/[病人]”)之后,在MTC-Dialog语中进行的,这样,干净和分心的录音笔录只因插入的行而异;被冻结的交换、器官系统标签和两个生成器提示将随MedDistractics(补充说明1)一起发布。

blocks.en: Note generation. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (revision 0e9e39f), Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (a09a354), Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 (c170c70) and Gemma-2-9B-it (11c9b30) generated one SOAP progress note for every clean and distracted transcript in MedDistractNotes (bfloat16 weights, greedy decoding, at most 1,024 new tokens, batches of two with left padding; PyTorch 2.5.1, transformers 4.57.6, one A100 80 GB GPU per job). We prompted each model to write a concise SOAP note based solely on the transcript. The instruction and transcript formed a single user turn in the model’s native chat template, which supplied the beginning-of-sequence token where defined (Gemma-2, Llama and Mistral). The factorial design of 576 encounters, two perturbation families and four models yielded 4,608 clean–distracted note pairs.
blocks.zh: 注释生成. Llama-3.1-8B-指令(修订为0e9e39f),Quen2.5-7B-指令(a09a354),Mistral-7B-struct-v0.3 (c170c70)和Gemma-2-9B-it (11c9b30)为MedDistract Notes中的每一份干净和分心的笔录(bfloat16重量,贪婪的解码,最多为1,024个新代币,分批为2个并有左后垫;PyTorch 2.5.1,变压器 4.57.6,每个工作1个A100 80GB GPU)生成一个SOAP进度说明. 我们促使每个模型只根据文字记录写出简明的SOAP说明. 指示和记录稿在模型的本地聊天模板中形成了一个单一的用户转弯,在定义的地方(Gemma-2、Llama和Mistral)提供了序列开始符号。 576个遭遇、2个扰动家庭和4个模型的因子设计产生了4 608个干净的二分音符对。

blocks.en: Frontier models. GPT-5.4, GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5 and Claude Fable 5.1 (OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, September 2026; through the providers’ batch endpoints) generated notes from the same clean and distracted transcripts. Each request used the same instruction and transcript in a single user message, with the provider’s default reasoning or thinking setting. We set temperature to 0 where supported; Claude 5 series models do not accept this setting. Output caps were 1,024 tokens for GPT models and 4,096 for Claude models. Two saved note records were empty, one from a failed GPT-5.4 request and one from a GPT-5.6 Sol response that exhausted its token cap during reasoning. Both remained in the primary analysis; excluding their pairs did not change the rounded frontier incorporation rate (Supplementary Note 3).
blocks.zh: 边疆模型. GPT-5.4,GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5和Claude Fable 5.1(OpenAI和Anthropic APIS,2026年9月;通过供应商的批发端点)从同样的干净而分心的笔录中产生了笔记. 每项请求在单一用户信息中使用相同的指令和笔录,提供商的默认推理或思维设置。 我们把温度设定到支持的 0;克洛德5系列模型不接受这个设置. GPT模型的输出封顶为1,024个令牌,克洛德模型为4,096个. 两个被保存的音符记录是空的,一个来自一个失败的GPT-5.4请求,另一个来自一个GPT-5.6 Sol响应,在推理时已经用尽了它的符号盖. 两者仍然处于初级分析之中;不包括他们的配对,并不改变四舍五入的边界注册率(补充说明3)。

blocks.en: Contamination judging. Claude Sonnet 5 evaluated contamination using a paired protocol (Anthropic API; September 2026). For each pair, it received the clean transcript, a one-sentence summary of the inserted content as the evaluation target, and the two notes presented in a randomized order. The instructions specified that the target was an evaluation criterion, that each note should be scored independently, that paraphrases and clinical consequences counted, and that unrelated hallucinations did not. For each note, the judge returned a binary judgement of clinically meaningful incorporation and a severity score from 0 to 3. Clean notes served as false-positive controls within encounters.
blocks.zh: 污染判断。 Claude Sonnet 5利用一对协议评估了污染(Anthropic API;2026年9月). 对于每对,它收到了干净的笔录,作为评价目标的被插入内容的一发式摘要,以及按随机排列顺序呈现的两张笔记. 说明中明确指出,目标是一个评价标准,每个音符都应该独立打分,解释和临床后果都算数,不相关的幻觉没有. 每张笔记,法官都回复了临床上有意义的并入的二进制判断和从0到3的重分. 干净的笔记在遭遇中起到了虚假的阳性控制作用.

blocks.en: GPT-5.4 (temperature 0) independently scored each note using the transcript and reference note for clinical correctness, completeness and succinctness on five-point scales, alongside a binary hallucination flag and overall quality score.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.4(温度为0)利用记录和参考说明对每张音符进行独立打分,以五分尺度的临床正确性,完整性和简洁性,并配有二进制幻觉旗帜和整体质量分数.

blocks.en: To test whether showing both notes affected scores, we used the same Claude Sonnet 5 judge to score all 18,432 saved notes one at a time. Each request contained the original clean transcript, the insertion summary and one note, without its condition label. The incorporation criterion and generation settings matched the paired protocol. We compared flag rates and agreement between protocols, with 95% intervals from 5,000 whole-encounter bootstrap resamples that retained all models and perturbations together (Extended Data Fig. 3). Full prompts, run settings and results are provided in Supplementary Notes 1 and 3.
blocks.zh: 为了测试这两个音符是否影响分数,我们用同名克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet)5的评分来评分所有18,432分一次保存了1分. 每一份请求都附有原始的清洁记录、插入摘要和一份说明,没有附带条件标签。 纳入标准和生成设置与配对协议相匹配。 我们比较了旗帜率和协议之间的协议,其中95%的间隔来自5 000个保留了所有模型和扰动的全相机靴套(扩展数据图3)。 补充说明1和3提供了全部提示、运行设置和结果。

blocks.en: Attribution. For each distracted note flagged for incorporation, a second Claude Sonnet 5 call received the clean transcript, the description of the inserted content and the note. It classified the note as presenting the content as clinical information about the patient, recording it with the correct meaning (e.g., as another person’s information or a non-clinical remark), or not mentioning it. It also assessed whether any assessment, diagnosis or plan item for the patient rested on the content. Empty replies were retried once. We report misattribution, correctly attributed clinical use and recorded-only mention as percentages of distracted notes in each cohort. The prompt appears in Supplementary Note 1. Of the 1,612 frontier notes flagged for incorporation, the attribution judge marked 15 as absent and five remained unresolved. The corresponding counts among 2,309 open-weight notes were 17 and ten. These notes remain in the denominator but outside the three attribution categories.
blocks.zh: 归依. 对于每个被标注为并入的分心笔记,第二通克洛德·索内特5号电话收到了干净的笔录,插入内容的描述和笔记. 它将该说明归类为将内容作为患者的临床信息,录入正确的含义(例如作为他人的信息或非临床评论),或者不提及. 它还评估了是否根据内容对病人进行评估、诊断或计划项目。 空回覆被重审一次. 我们报告分配不当,将临床用途正确归为正确,只记录在每一组人中分心的笔记的百分比。 该提示见补充说明1。 在标出要并入的1 612份边界照会中,归属法官标出15份缺席,有5份仍未解决。 2 309个开放式纸币的相应数字是17个和10个。 这些说明留在分母中,但不属于三个归属类别。

blocks.en: Failure-mode analysis. For each distracted note in MedDistractNotes, we matched the aside’s content words (condition, procedure, device, medication or figurative item) to note lines. Each matching line was assigned to the nearest preceding section header (chief complaint or history of present illness; past medical, surgical or medication history and review of systems; family or social history; other subjective; objective; assessment; plan), recognizing the “S/O/A/P”, “Subjective/Objective/Assessment/Plan” and long-form header styles the models use. This procedure located content in 94–99% of notes incorporating bystander exchanges and 54–80% of notes incorporating nonliteral exchanges, which were often paraphrased.
blocks.zh: 失败模式分析. 在MedDistract Notes中, 每一个分散注意力的字句, 都对应旁白的内容(条件、程序、设备、药物或比喻项目), 每个匹配行被分配到最近的前一节标题上(主投诉或当前病史;过去的医疗、手术或药物史和制度审查;家庭或社会史;其他主观;目标;评估;计划),承认“S/O/A/P”、“主观/目标/评估/计划”和模型使用的长式标题样式。 这一程序在包含旁观者交换的94-99%的纸币和包含非文学交换的54-80%的纸币中找到内容,这些纸币常常被作解释。

blocks.en: Misattributed and acted-on notes were then grouped into failure modes by a fixed, ordered list of keyword rules applied to the attribution judge’s rationale, the contamination judge’s rationale and the matching note lines: small talk documented as a mental-status or psychiatric sign (tangential, off-topic, cognitive, mental status, confusion, anxiety, panic, psychiatric); another person’s condition becoming the patient’s complaint or diagnosis (chief complaint, primary diagnosis, the patient’s own condition, surgical history, status post); recorded as family history or a risk factor (family history, hereditary, familial, risk factor); read as an unvoiced concern with screening or counselling added (unvoiced, screen, counsel, inquire, interest in, explore); recorded as the patient’s own activity or social history (activity, social history, recreational, plays, participates); and a figurative remark recorded as a fact about the patient (converts, recasts, misrepresents, literal, factual, fabricated). The first matching rule determined the mode; unmatched notes were classified as other. The rules, the per-note assignments and verbatim examples for every mode and model will be released (Supplementary Note 2), and the examples in Table 1 are reproduced from the notes without editing beyond abridgement.
blocks.zh: 然后,根据归属法官的理由、污染法官的理由和对应的注释线,按固定的、按顺序排列的关键词清单,将错误的和动作的笔记归类为失败模式:作为精神状态或精神症状(症状、非主题、认知、心理状况、混乱、焦虑、恐慌、心理状态)、另一人的情况成为病人的申诉或诊断(主申诉、初级诊断、病人自身状况、外科历史、状况);被记录为家庭历史或风险因素(家庭历史、世袭、家庭、风险因素);被解读为对筛选或咨询的无声关注(无声、屏幕、律师、询问、兴趣、探索);被记录为病人自己的活动或社会历史(活动、社会历史、娱乐、游戏、参与);被记录为病人事实的类似评论(转录、歪曲、文字、事实、捏造)。 第一个匹配规则确定了模式;未匹配的注释被归类为其他. 规则、每种模式和模式的每笔说明任务和逐字记录将予公布(补充说明2),表1中的例子从说明中转录而未经编辑。

blocks.en: Statistics for MedDistractNotes. Each clean–distracted note pair contributed a paired contamination difference. The reported bootstrap resampled note pairs; pooled analyses did not cluster all models and perturbations from the same encounter. The primary estimand is the pooled (encounter-weighted) mean difference over all note pairs of a cohort (4,608 per cohort) and separately by model, perturbation family, corpus and their combinations, with 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals from 2,000 note-pair resamples 28 . An additional analysis resampled whole encounters, retaining all models and perturbations together (5,000 resamples; Supplementary Note 3). The unweighted mean over the 40 model × \times dataset-split × \times perturbation strata is reported alongside because the strata differ in size from 11 to 200 encounters. Attribution outcomes and failure modes are reported as percentages of distracted notes in each cohort with the same note-pair bootstrap. We analysed quality scores as paired differences using the same procedure. The association between transcript length and contamination was assessed within MTS-Dialog by Spearman correlation and by pooled differences within quintiles of clean-transcript length, and across the cohort by a logistic regression of distracted-note contamination on the relative position of the inserted exchange (turn index divided by the number of turns) and log10 transcript length. Agreement between paired and single-note protocols is reported as percentage agreement and Cohen’s κ \kappa .
blocks.zh: 《医学差异说明》的统计。 每对清洁-分解的纸条都造成一对相差的污染。 所报告的靴子圈被重印成对;集合分析没有将同一遭遇的所有模型和扰动组合起来。 主要的印象是集合(反加权)一个组群中所有音符对(每组4,608个)的平均值差异,并按型号、扰动家庭、体格及其组合分别列出,其中从2,000个音符-音符再印出28个音符的间隔为95%。 附加分析再模拟整个相遇情况,保留所有模型和扰动在一起(5 000个相接;补充说明3)。 40个模型的未加权平均值x\times数据集-分解x\times 扰动层被同时报告,因为层大小不同,从11到200个相遇. 报告分配结果和失败模式为每组有同一种记事本的记事本的百分比。 我们用同样的程序将质量分数作为配对差异进行分析。 记录片长度与污染之间的联系在MTS-Dialog内部由Spearman的关联关系和在清洁记录片长度的五分之一之内的集合差异加以评估,在组群中则通过对插入的交换器相对位置的分心音符污染(转折指数除以转折次数)和对数10记录片长度的逻辑回归加以评估。 成对协议和单注协议之间的协议被报告为百分比协议和Cohen的"\kappa".

blocks.en: MedDistractAudio benchmark. We tested acoustic contamination using PriMock57, a public corpus of 57 mock primary-care consultations recorded as separate 16-kHz doctor and patient channels with utterance-level transcripts and clinician notes (CC BY 4.0) 21 . For each consultation A, we combined the two channels into one track and selected two donor consultations B with a fixed seed, excluding A. From each donor, we selected a 5–15 s window with the densest clinical content, measured by keyword count in the human transcript. We overlaid this segment at a fixed onset within the middle 60% of A, at − - 20, − - 15, − - 10 and − - 5 dB relative to A’s root-mean-square level. Mixes were peak-normalized. The unmodified track served as the clean control, yielding 57 clean and 456 mixed recordings.
blocks.zh: MedDistractAudio基准。 我们用PriMock57测试了声学污染, 这是57个模拟初级保健咨询的公文集, 记录为单独的16克 Hz 医生和病人频道,配有语音记录和临床笔记(CC BY 4.0) 21。 每一次A级诊疗,我们把两个频道合并为一条轨道,选择了两个有固定种子的B级捐赠者诊疗,不包括A级。 从每个捐献者那里,我们选择了一个5–15 s 的窗口,其中包含最密集的临床内容,用人类笔录中的关键词数来衡量. 我们在A中间的60%范围内固定地铺设了这一段,与A的根-正平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平 混合体被峰值正常化。 未经修改的曲目起到了清控的作用,产生了57个清唱和456个混音.

blocks.en: Clean and mixed audio were transcribed with Whisper large-v3 22 (greedy decoding, English, 30-s chunks, no diarization), and the same four open-weight models generated SOAP notes from the transcripts with the protocol above. Transcription leakage was defined as the fraction of content words of the overlaid segment (alphabetic, at least four characters, stop words removed) that appeared in the mixed transcript but not in the clean transcript of A. Contamination was scored with the paired judge described above, with the human transcript of the overlaid segment as the target, prefixed as content from a different patient’s consultation. Prespecified endpoints were the pooled contamination difference at − - 10 dB (primary), transcription leakage and contamination by level, and contamination conditional on leakage.
blocks.zh: 清和混音被与Whisper大-v3 22(greedy decoding,英语,30-s块,没有分化)相接而来,同四种开量型号从与上方协议的笔录中生成了SOAP笔记. 译出渗漏的定义是,在混合记录中出现,但没有在A的清洁记录中出现的内容单词的分量(α字,至少四个字符被去掉)。 污染与上述配对裁判一起被打入了分数,被填入部分的人的笔录作为目标,前缀为不同病人咨询的内容。 指定的终点是---10分贝(主要分贝)的集合污染差、记录分层泄漏和污染以及以泄漏为条件的污染。

blocks.en: The consultation was the resampling unit, with its donors and models resampled together. We estimated mixed-minus-clean paired differences with 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals over consultations (2,000 resamples), and summarized leakage at each level using the same bootstrap. We assessed the association between leakage and contamination by Spearman correlation across mixes. Two of 1,824 note pairs were excluded because judge outputs could not be parsed.
blocks.zh: 协商是重新取样单位,其捐助者和模式一起重新取样。 我们估计了混合-减-净配对差异,在磋商过程中有95%的靴子置信间隔(2 000个复标),并用同一种靴子对每一级渗出进行总结。 我们评估了渗出和污染之间的联系 由Spearman在混合体之间的关联。 在1 824个附注中,有2个被排除在外,因为无法分析法官的产出。

blocks.en: MedDistractQA items used as the mechanistic probe. The mechanistic experiments used the items of MedDistractQA, our released benchmark 7 , which extends the 1,273-item test split of MedQA-USMLE (four-option version) 23 . For each item, one nonliteral and one bystander sentence were generated with GPT-4o (temperature 0.6, February 2025) from a prompt with five fixed example sentences, the clean question and a “clinical topic” defined deterministically as the text of the first incorrect answer option in letter order, to make the inserted sentence reuse vocabulary from an incorrect option; the sentence was inserted immediately before the final sentence of the question stem and conveys no information about the patient. The fixed examples led the generated sentences to reuse a small set of frames. Most bystander sentences follow the form “the patient’s aunt mentioned that her friend’s parrot …”. Each clean–distracted pair nevertheless contains the same options and correct answer. The dataset is released with item identifiers, clean questions, both distracted variants and the inserted sentences.
blocks.zh: 医学差异 用作机械探测器的QA物品. 机械实验使用了我们公布的基准7“MedDistractQA”的项目,该基准延长了MedQA-USMLE(四可选版本)的1,273项测试分出23。 对于每个项目,用GPT-4o(温度为0.6,2025年2月)生成了一个非读取和旁观的句子,从一个带有五个固定示例句子的快取出干净的问题和一个“临床话题 ” , 将定义为第一个错误的答案选项的文字顺序,使插入的句子重复使用词汇从错误的选项中产生出来;该句子紧接在问题最后句子开始前插入,没有传递关于病人的信息。 固定的例子导致生成的句子被再用到一小组框. 多数旁观者的句子都沿用了 " 病人的姨妈提到她朋友的鹦鹉... " 的形式。 然而,每对干净的二分法都包含同样的选择和正确的答案。 数据集发布时有项目标识符,干净的问题,既有分心变体,也有被插入的句子.

blocks.en: Mechanistic evaluation. The four note-generating models were evaluated on MedDistractQA by conditional log-probability. Each item was formatted as a fixed instruction, the question, the four lettered options and “Answer:”, wrapped in the model’s native chat template (question and options as the user turn, which supplies the beginning-of-sequence token where the tokenizer defines one) with “Answer:” opening the assistant turn; the model’s prediction is the option letter with the highest mean log-probability of its single-token target. Items were split deterministically (seed 0) into 1,146 training items, used only to fit gates, and 127 held-out items. All intervention results in the main text were evaluated on the 127 held-out items for each of the four models. Runs used bfloat16 weights on one A100 80 GB GPU.
blocks.zh: 机械评价. 在MedDistractQA上,以有条件的对数概率评价了这四个出纸币模型. 每个项目被格式化为固定指令,问题,四个字母选项和"Answer:",包裹在模型的本地聊天模板中(问题和选项作为用户转弯,在标语器定义一个时提供序列的起始符),并用"Answer:"打开助手转弯;模型的预测是其单指目标的最小对数概率最高的选项字母. 物品按定数(种子0)分为1 146个训练物品,只用于装配大门,127个被搁置的物品。 对正文中的所有干预结果,对四个模型中每个模型的127个搁置项目进行了评价。 跑道在一台A100 80GB GPU上使用了bfloat16重量.

blocks.en: Contrastive causal head gating. CCHG extends causal head gating 24 to a paired objective. A multiplicative gate g h = σ \sigma ( z h ) is applied to the output of every attention head before the output projection. Gate logits are initialized at zero (gates at 0.5), and the loss on a batch of paired items is the mean over items of [log p( y i | x i clean ) − - log p( y i | x i distracted )] 29 plus λ \lambda times the mean over heads of (1 − - g h ), with λ \lambda = 5. The first term reduces the difference in correct-answer log-probability between the paired inputs. The second pulls gates towards one, penalizing attenuation. Gates are applied in both forward passes. The objective can therefore decrease either by raising distracted or by lowering clean log-probability. Selected heads contribute to the difference in answer probability between the paired inputs. We fixed λ \lambda a priori at 5 for all models and families without tuning. The selected fraction depends on λ \lambda and compares models under a common penalty; it is not an intrinsic model property.

blocks.en: To measure seed stability, the gates were retrained with optimization seeds 1–3 under identical data, hyperparameters and update count (for Gemma-2-9B, micro-batches of one pair with 16 accumulation steps replaced the 2 × \times 8 configuration because eager attention exceeded GPU memory; the effective batch and objective are unchanged), and reproducibility was summarized by the mean pairwise Jaccard similarity between seeds, the Jaccard similarity of each seed with the published seed-0 set and the fraction of published heads selected by at least two seeds; the expected Jaccard similarity of two random sets of the observed sizes is given for reference.

blocks.en: Activation patching and suppression. For clean-activation patching, we replaced selected-head outputs on the distracted input with outputs recorded on the clean input. Token positions were aligned using the longest common prefix and suffix of the two sequences. Inserted tokens had no clean counterpart and were left unpatched. Controls patched an equal number of randomly chosen heads (drawn with a fixed seed from the non-selected heads), or all heads. The comparator is the same pipeline’s accuracy on the distracted held-out items without intervention.
blocks.zh: 活性补丁与抑制. 对于清洁活性补丁,我们用在清洁输入上记录的产出取代了分散投入上选定的标题产出。 Token位置是使用两个序列中最长的共同前缀和后缀对齐的. 插入的指使没有干净的对应物,没有被标注。 控件补齐了相同数量的随机选取的头(从非选取的头部抽取出固定的种子),或全部头部. 比较者在不干预的情况下对分散注意力的搁置项目是同一管道的准确性。

blocks.en: Suppression multiplies the outputs of the selected heads by a factor of 1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25 or 0 on both clean and distracted inputs, with 0 corresponding to removal; as a control, a size-matched set of heads drawn at random (fixed seed) from the non-selected heads was scaled in the same way. Changes are computed relative to the factor-1 evaluation of the same pipeline.
blocks.zh: 压制将所选头的输出乘以1,0.75,0.5,0.25或0的系数,既在干净又在分心的输入上进行,而0对应去除;作为控制,以随机(固定种子)从非被选头抽取的大小相匹配的一组头被以同样的方式缩放. 变化是参照同一管道的因数-1评价计算的。

blocks.en: For patching and suppression, each intervention was compared with the unmodified evaluation under the same chat-template and scoring protocol.
blocks.zh: 对于补丁和压制,将每一次干预与同一聊天-模板和评分协议下的未修改评价进行比较。

blocks.en: As a descriptive diagnostic, we also measured the attention from the position at which the answer is predicted to the inserted tokens, in selected versus other heads. This diagnostic used the same 127 held-out items for all four models. An exploratory learned per-head correction (a small network trained to map the selected heads’ distracted activations to their clean activations) changed held-out accuracy by at most 0.8 percentage points and is not used to support any claim. Prompting comparisons in these models used the same log-probability scoring with an added instruction to ignore irrelevant information or with a chain-of-thought preamble.
blocks.zh: 作为一种描述性诊断,我们还从预测答案的位置到插入的指针,从选定的头到其他头来衡量了注意力。 这种诊断对所有四种模型都使用了相同的127个被搁置的物品. 试探性的每头修正(一个训练有素的小型网络,将选定的头部的分心活化情况映射到其干净活化情况),其被搁置的准确度最多为0.8个百分点,并不用于支持任何主张。 在这些模型中进行提示性比较时,使用了相同的日志概率分数,加上一个附加指示,忽略了不相干的信息,或者使用了思维链前言.

blocks.en: Mechanistic statistics. Accuracy changes on the 127 held-out items are paired differences with 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals over items (2,000 resamples) and exact McNemar tests; Benjamini–Hochberg correction 30 was applied within the family of eight baseline clean-versus-distracted changes (Fig. 4a), of which seven remained significant; patching and suppression comparisons are reported with uncorrected exact McNemar P values. Comparisons across models are descriptive.
